prerequisites: Must have passed at least 120 ECTS of the study plan.
Students who have completed the entire study load of their degree plan are not eligible.

learning_outcomes.text: Contribute to the comprehensive training of students, complementing their theoretical and practical teachings.
Facilitate knowledge of the appropriate work methodology for the professional reality in which students will operate as graduates, contrasting and applying acquired knowledge.
Prepare students for working in teams.
Foster the development of students' decision-making capacity and critical spirit.

syllabus_topics: Design of a training project, specifying educational objectives and professional activities for the internship agreement.
Particular conditions of each internship placement, collected in an annex to the agreement, approved by the Center, and formalized in standardized educational contract models.
Signing of the annex by the student, two tutors, and the Center's Internship Program Manager.
Submission of a copy of the annex to the Vice-Rectorate responsible for Students.

assessment_methods.method: Academic Tutor's Monitoring Grade (Nota del Seguimiento)

assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as 0.5 * Internship Report Grade + 0.5 * Monitoring Grade. A minimum of 4 points is required in both the Internship Report Grade and the Monitoring Grade to pass the course. The final grade must be 5 or higher to pass the course. If the minimum in the Internship Report Grade and/or the Monitoring Grade is not reached, the maximum final grade will be 4 points. Extraordinary calls follow the same procedure as the ordinary call.
